buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms.

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1) Please Refer Section-II of Buyer uploaded ATC document for bid evaluation criteria & submit documents accordingly. 2) Kindly submit all forms & formats available in buyer uploaded ATC document duly fill ed, signed & stamped. 3) Bid shall be accompanied by Earnest Money Deposit of Rs. 49,000 for all the line ite ms. For details refer Clause No 16 of ITB (Section III of Buyer uploaded ATC document). 4) After Award of Contract, in case of any variance in the terms and conditions between GEM con t ract and SAP PO/LOA, the terms and conditions of SAP PO/LOA shall prevail. 5) MSE bidders participating in the tender should submit their UDYAM registration certificate duly certified by Chartered Accountant and Notary Public with legal stamp. 6)Technical Specifications shall be as per Section-VI of the Buyer Added Bid specific ATC doc ument. Bidders shall submit SCC, Technical Specifications and SOR sheets mentioned in t he Sections - V, VI and VII of the Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC document duly signed and stam ped as a token of acceptance. 7) Land-border Undertaking i.e., Form-IA to Section II and Form-IB to Section II of the Buyer Added Bid specific ATC document must be submitted duly filled, signed and stamped (as applicabl e) on your company's letterhead. 8) Power of Attorney (PoA) on the name of the person signing the bid documents must be issued o n your company's letterhead. 9)GST and PAN certificates of the Firm must be attached. 10) PAN, Aadhar Copies of all the Partners/Proprietor /Directors must be attached duly atteste d by Notary Public with legible stamp. 11) Format F-12 of the Buyer Added Bid specific ATC document must be duly filled, signed and st amped on your company's letterhead 12)In order to avail benefit of Poli cy for Purchase preference- to domestically manufactured Electronic Pro duct under MII order, eligible bidders shall submit duly filled FORM-2 (SELF CERTIFICATION BY BIDDER WH O CLASS-I LOCAL SUPPLIER/ CLASS-II LOCAL SUPPLIER TOWARDS MANDATORY MINIMUM LOCAL CONTENT/ DOMESTIC VALUE ADDITION). 13) Only ‘ Class-I local supplier’ and ‘Class-II local supplier’, shall be eligible to bid in the instant tender. ‘ Non-local suppliers' shall not be eligible to bid.
